Integer Programming
Indiscreteoptimisation problems, we seek to ﬁnd a solutionx ⋆ in a
discrete setPthat optimises (minimises or maximises) an objective
functionf 0(x)deﬁned for allx∈ P
– discrete optimisation problems arise in a great variety of contexts
– a natural and systematic way to study a broad class of discrete
optimisation problems is to express them as integer programming
problems
– the (linear) integer programming problem is the same as the linear
programming problem except that some of the variables are
restricted to take integer values

Forcing constraints
A very common feature in discrete optimisation problems is that certain
decisions are dependent.
More speciﬁcally, suppose decisionAcan be made only if decisionBhas
also been made.
In order to model such a situation, we introduce binary variablesx
(respectively,y) equal to 1 if decisionA(respectively,B) is chosen, and 0
otherwise
The dependence of the two decisions can be modelled using the
constraint:
x≤y

Generalizing disjunctive constraints I
Suppose we are given two constraints of the form
f(x)≤0
g(x)≤0
We want to make sure that at least one of them is satisﬁed.
In order to achieve this, we deﬁne a binary variableyand impose the constraints
f(x)≤My
g(x)≤M(1−y)
whereMis a number chosen large enough to ensure that
f(x)≤Mandg(x)≤M
are satisﬁed for all values ofxthat satisfy the other constraints in the problem.
This type of constraint is sometimes called ‘Either-or constraints’ in some textbooks.

In other words, we want to ensure thatf(x)>0impliesg(x)≥0.
T o ensure this, we include the following constraints in the formulation

Set-covering problem
In aset-covering problem, each member of a given set (call it setA) must be “covered” by an acceptable
member of some other set (call it setB).
Theobjectiveof a set-covering problem is to minimize the number of elements in setBthat are required
to cover all the elements in setA.
Example: There are six cities in Kilroy County (cities 1–6). The county must determine where to build ﬁre
stations. The county wants to build the minimum number of ﬁre stations needed to ensure that at least
one ﬁre station is within 15 minutes (driving time) of each city. The times (in minutes) required to drive
between the cities in Kilroy County are shown in the table below. Formulate an IP that will tell Kilroy how
many ﬁre stations should be built and where they should be located.

Algorithms
Unlike LPs, IPs are very diﬃcult to solve.
In fact, noeﬃcientgeneral algorithm is known for their solution.
There are three main categories of algorithms:
▶Exact algorithms: guaranteed to ﬁnd an optimal solution, but may
take an exponential number of iterations (e.g. branch-and-bound,
cutting plane)
▶Approximation algorithms: provide in polynomial time a suboptimal
solution with a bound on suboptimality.
▶Heuristic algorithms: provide a suboptimal solution, but without a
guarantee on its quality.

Consider an integer program

▶recursively partitionPinto smaller setsP i and solve subproblems

subject tox∈ P i
▶use LP relaxations to discard subproblems that don’t lead to a
solution
30 / 60

Branch-and-bound algorithm: overview
▶Solve the LP relaxation of the original IP . If the solution is integer, then stop.
▶If not, pick a variable whose value in the LP relaxation is fractional. For the sake of argument,
suppose that this variable isx 1 and its value in the LP relaxation is3.75. We can then exclude this
value by imposing the restrictionsx 1 ≤3.0andx 1 ≥4.0.
▶If the original IP is denotedP 0, then we might denote these two new IPs byP 1, wherex 1 ≤3.0is
imposed, andP 2, wherex 1 ≥ 4.0 is imposed. The variablex 1 is then called abranching variable, and
we are said to have branched onx 1.
▶We now apply the same idea to these two IPs, solving the corresponding LP relaxations and, if
necessary, selecting branching variables. In so doing we generate what is called asearch tree. The
IPs generated by the search procedure are called thenodesof the tree, withP 0 designated as the
root node. The leaves of the tree are all the nodes from which we have not yet branched.
In general, if we reach a point at which we can solve or otherwise dispose of all leaf nodes, then we will
have solved the original IP .
31 / 60

Branch-and-bound algorithm:
fathomed and incumbent nodes
The best integer solution found at any point in the search is called theincumbent. At the start of the
search, we have no incumbent.
Suppose that we have just solved the LP relaxation of some node in the search tree. If all variables have
integer values, then we know we have found a feasible solution to the original IP .
There aretwoimportant steps that we then take:
▶We designate this node asfathomed. It is not necessary to branch on this node; it is a permanent
leaf of the search tree.
▶If the integer feasible solution that we have just found has a better objective function value than the
current incumbent (or if we have no incumbent), then we record this solution as the new incumbent,
along with its objective function value.
There are two other possibilities that can lead to a node being fathomed.
▶the LP relaxation at this node is infeasible.
▶the value of the LP relaxation is smaller than that of the current incumbent.
In both cases, it is not necessary to branch on this node.
32 / 60

Branch-and-bound algorithm: best bound and gap
First, observe that theobjective value for the incumbentis avalid lower boundon the optimal solution of
the given IP (assuming the original IP is a maximization problem).
Second, at any time during the branch-and-bound search we also have avalid upper bound, sometimes
called thebest bound. This bound is obtained by taking the maximum of the optimal objective values of
all of the current leaf nodes.
The diﬀerence between the current upper and lower bounds is calledoptimality gap(or thegap). It can be
relative (% of the LP objective value) and absolute.
When the optimality gap is zero we have demonstrated optimality.

Cutting plane algorithm
A generic cutting plane algorithm:
1. Solve the LP relaxation. Letx ⋆ be an optimal solution.
2. Ifx ⋆ is integer, stop;x ⋆ is an optimal solution to the IP .
3. If not, add a linear inequality constraint to the LP relaxation that all
integer solutions to IP satisfy, butx ⋆ does not; go to Step 1.

title: 整数建模、分支定界与割平面
Integer modeling, branch-and-bound and cuts
overview: 从不能简单取整的例子出发，学习逻辑建模、搜索证书与强松弛。
Start with rounding failures, then study logical modeling, search certificates and strong relaxations.
goals: 使用二元变量与有效 Big-M
Use binaries and valid Big-M bounds
跟踪分支定界的上下界
推导有效割并比较模型强度
Derive valid cuts and compare formulation strength

title: 整数、混合整数与二元规划
Integer, mixed-integer and binary programming
lecture: 离散优化在离散集合中找最优解。ILP 保持线性目标和约束，但变量取整数；MIP 只限制部分变量为整数；0–1 规划用二元变量表达两种选择。本讲随后讨论建模、算法、强模型与 TSP。

Discrete optimization searches a discrete feasible set. ILP keeps linear objectives/constraints but restricts variables to integers; MIP restricts only some, and binary programs use 0–1 choices. The lecture then covers modeling, algorithms, strong formulations and TSP.

title: 取整为何不能替代整数求解
Why rounding is not an IP algorithm
lecture: 最大化 3x₁+4x₂，5x₁+8x₂≤24，非负整数。LP 解 (4.8,0)，值 14.4；四舍五入成 (5,0) 不可行；截断为 (4,0) 值 12；真正整数最优为 (3,1)，值 13。

Maximize 3x₁+4x₂ with 5x₁+8x₂≤24 and nonnegative integers. The LP solution (4.8,0) has value 14.4; rounding to (5,0) is infeasible, truncating to (4,0) gives 12, while the integer optimum (3,1) gives 13.
explanation: 枚举 x₂=0,1,2,3 时最大可行整数 x₁ 分别 4,3,1,0，目标分别 12,13,11,12，验证最优为 13。
For x₂=0,1,2,3 the largest feasible integer x₁ is 4,3,1,0, yielding 12,13,11,12; this verifies 13.

title: 排班重访与 LP 松弛
Scheduling revisited and LP relaxation
lecture: 五连班两休模型与 Lecture 3 相同，需求 (17,13,15,19,14,16,11)。LP 人数 22⅓，向上取整 25，截断不可行，整数最优 23，对应 (4,4,2,6,0,4,3)。删除整数条件扩大可行域；最大化得到上界，最小化得到下界。若最优松弛解恰好整数，它也解出 IP。

The five-on/two-off schedule repeats Lecture 3 with requirements (17,13,15,19,14,16,11). LP headcount is 22⅓, upward rounding gives 25, truncation is infeasible, and integer optimum 23 uses (4,4,2,6,0,4,3). Removing integrality enlarges feasibility: an upper bound for maximization, lower bound for minimization. An integral optimal relaxation solution also solves the IP.
explanation: 整数等价的两个模型可能有不同的 LP 松弛，这会影响算法效率。
Integer-equivalent formulations can have different LP relaxations and computational behavior.

title: 背包与 Stockco 投资选择
Knapsack and Stockco choices
lecture: 二元 xⱼ 表示是否选物品，重量 wⱼ、价值 vⱼ、容量 W。Stockco 预算 14 千元，六项投资现金需求 (5,7,4,3,4,6)，NPV (16,22,12,8,11,19)，单位千元；课件给数据和问题，未给解。

Binary xⱼ selects items with weights wⱼ and values vⱼ under capacity W. Stockco has a budget of 14 thousand, investment costs (5,7,4,3,4,6) and NPVs (16,22,12,8,11,19), in thousands. The slides provide data but no solution.
explanation: 按课件数据，选择 1、4、6 花费 5+3+6=14，NPV=16+8+19=43。网站附带本地枚举核验，作为 Codex 补充计算。
Selecting 1,4,6 costs 14 and yields NPV 43. This is a Codex calculation checked by local enumeration, not a printed slide answer.

title: 依赖关系与设施选址
Dependencies and facility location
lecture: 若 A 只能在 B 被选时选择，用二元变量 x≤y。设施选址中 yⱼ 表示开设设施 j，xᵢⱼ 表示客户 i 由 j 服务。每个客户恰分配一次，xᵢⱼ≤yⱼ 防止未开设施服务客户。成本为固定开设成本加服务成本。

If A can be chosen only when B is chosen, use binary x≤y. In facility location, yⱼ opens facility j and xᵢⱼ assigns client i to it. Every client is assigned once and xᵢⱼ≤yⱼ forbids service from closed facilities. Cost combines opening and service.

title: 数量逻辑与有限取值
Cardinality and finite values
lecture: 二元变量之和≤1 表示至多一个，=1 恰一个，≥2 至少两个，=3 恰三个。要令 x 仅取 {a₁,…,aₘ}，用恰一个 yⱼ=1 并令 x=Σaⱼyⱼ。课件例子允许 x∈{0,0.5,1,1.5,2}。

For binary variables, sum≤1 means at most one, =1 exactly one, ≥2 at least two, and =3 exactly three. To restrict x to {a₁,…,aₘ}, select exactly one yⱼ and set x=Σaⱼyⱼ. The example allows {0,0.5,1,1.5,2}.

title: 非负条件下的析取约束
Disjunction under nonnegativity
lecture: 若 x≥0、a≥0、c≥0，至少满足 aᵀx≥b 或 cᵀx≥d，可写 aᵀx≥yb、cᵀx≥(1−y)d，y 二元。推广至 m 条至少满足 k 条时，aᵢᵀx≥yᵢbᵢ，Σyᵢ≥k。
When x,a,c are nonnegative, require at least one of aᵀx≥b or cᵀx≥d by using aᵀx≥yb and cᵀx≥(1−y)d with binary y. For at least k of m constraints use aᵢᵀx≥yᵢbᵢ and Σyᵢ≥k.
explanation: 被关闭的约束变成左端≥0；正是非负假设使它自动成立，不能去掉这些条件照搬。
The disabled condition becomes left-side≥0; nonnegativity makes it automatic. Do not reuse this form without its assumptions.

title: Big-M 析取与条件数量
Big-M disjunctions and counts
lecture: 至少满足 f(x)≤0 或 g(x)≤0：f≤My、g≤M(1−y)。m 条至少 k 条可用 fᵢ≤Myᵢ、Σyᵢ≤m−k。M 必须覆盖其他约束允许范围内的相应表达式。
For f≤0 or g≤0, use f≤My and g≤M(1−y). At least k of m conditions use fᵢ≤Myᵢ and Σyᵢ≤m−k. M must bound the relevant expressions over all other feasible choices.
explanation: f、g 必须是仿射表达式才能保持 MILP。M 太小会误删可行解，太大削弱松弛；优先从变量界推导有限紧界。
f,g must be affine for a MILP. Too-small M removes valid choices; excessively large M weakens relaxation. Derive tight finite bounds.

title: Dorian：不开工或至少生产 1000
Dorian: zero or at least 1000 cars
lecture: 小型、中型、大型车利润 (2000,3000,4000)，钢材 (1.5,3,5) 吨，工时 (30,25,40)。钢材 6000、工时 60000，每类若生产须≥1000。课件用 x₁≤M₁y₁ 和 1000−x₁≤M₁(1−y₁) 说明小型车析取。

Compact/midsize/large profits are (2000,3000,4000), steel (1.5,3,5) tons, labor (30,25,40) hours. Supplies are 6000 steel and 60000 labor. Each produced type must have at least 1000 units. The slide illustrates compact cars with x₁≤M₁y₁ and 1000−x₁≤M₁(1−y₁).
explanation: 补充完整紧界模型：最大化 2000x₁+3000x₂+4000x₃；1.5x₁+3x₂+5x₃≤6000，30x₁+25x₂+40x₃≤60000；1000yᵢ≤xᵢ≤Uᵢyᵢ，U=(2000,2000,1200)，x 为非负整数，y 二元。U 分别由钢材与工时的单产品上界取较小值。

Added full formulation: maximize 2000x₁+3000x₂+4000x₃; impose 1.5x₁+3x₂+5x₃≤6000 and 30x₁+25x₂+40x₃≤60000; use 1000yᵢ≤xᵢ≤Uᵢyᵢ with U=(2000,2000,1200), nonnegative integer x and binary y. Each U is the smaller individual steel/labor bound.

title: Big-M 条件蕴含
Big-M if–then implication
lecture: 若 f(x)>0 蕴含 g(x)≥0，可引入二元 y 并要求 −g(x)≤My、f(x)≤M(1−y)。这是课件 if–then 模型。
To encode f(x)>0 implying g(x)≥0, introduce binary y and impose −g(x)≤My and f(x)≤M(1−y), as in the slide.
explanation: 检查两支：y=0 强制 g≥0；y=1 强制 f≤0，此时前件 f>0 不成立。两支并集表达 f≤0 或 g≥0。M 仍需有效上界，不能任意选择。
When y=0, g≥0 is enforced; when y=1, f≤0 makes the antecedent false. Their union is f≤0 or g≥0. M still requires valid bounds.

title: Kilroy 消防站集合覆盖
Kilroy fire-station set covering
lecture: 每城必须在 15 分钟内到达至少一站。第 22 页给完整 6×6 驾车时间表；从表得到各城可覆盖站址集合：{1,2}、{1,2,6}、{3,4}、{3,4,5}、{4,5,6}、{2,5,6}。xᵢ 表示城市 i 建站，最少建站数为 2，课件解在城市 2、4 建站。第 25 页仅现场编程提示。

Each city needs a station within 15 minutes. The full driving-time table is on page 22; acceptable station sets are {1,2},{1,2,6},{3,4},{3,4,5},{4,5,6},{2,5,6}. Binary xᵢ builds a station in city i. The lecture optimum is two stations, in cities 2 and 4. Page 25 only prompts coding.
explanation: 至少两站的下界：覆盖城市 1 需从 {1,2} 选，覆盖城市 3 需从不相交的 {3,4} 选。课件方案达到两站，因此最优。
At least two stations are necessary: city 1 requires {1,2}, city 3 the disjoint set {3,4}. The reported solution attains this bound.

title: 效率与公平：双目标权衡
Efficiency and equity: two objectives
lecture: 城市公平影响分数 E=(8,2,4,3,9,7)。覆盖约束不变，目标为 w₁Σxᵢ−w₂ΣEᵢxᵢ。纯效率 (1,0) 选 2、4 两站，公平分 5；课件平衡方案 (10,1) 选 1、3、5 三站，公平分 21，加权目标 30−21=9。

Equity scores are E=(8,2,4,3,9,7). Keep coverage constraints and minimize w₁Σxᵢ−w₂ΣEᵢxᵢ. Pure efficiency (1,0) selects cities 2,4 with score 5; the reported (10,1) plan selects 1,3,5 with score 21 and weighted value 9.
explanation: 权重反映偏好和单位尺度，不是客观唯一答案。离散问题中加权和不一定找到所有 Pareto 有效点。此处 EIS 是课件给定示例评分。
Weights encode preferences and scaling, not a uniquely objective choice. Weighted sums need not recover every Pareto-efficient discrete solution. EIS values here are supplied by the lecture.

title: 分支定界：节点、在位解和界
Branch-and-bound: nodes, incumbent and bounds
lecture: 精确算法给最优性保证但最坏可能很慢；近似算法带质量界，启发式不保证质量。分支定界解 LP 松弛，若某整数变量为 3.75，分为 ≤3 和 ≥4。节点 LP 不可行、得到整数最优解、或界不优于在位解时可剪枝。最大化中在位整数值为下界，尚未剪枝节点的 LP 上界给全局上界；界差为 gap。

Exact methods guarantee optimality but may be slow in the worst case; approximation methods have quality bounds, heuristics no such guarantee. Branch-and-bound solves LP relaxations and splits a fractional 3.75 into ≤3 or ≥4. Fathom infeasible, integral-optimal or nonimproving-bound nodes. In maximization the incumbent is a lower bound; active-node LP bounds yield an upper bound. Their difference is the gap.
explanation: 必须用“最优松弛解是整数”来结束节点，而不是发现任意整数点就结束。无活跃节点时，最优值由在位解确定；保留在位值以维护全局上界。

Fathom because the optimal relaxation solution is integral, not merely because an arbitrary integer point was found. With no active nodes, the incumbent determines the optimum; retain its value in global-bound bookkeeping.

title: 分支定界例题：根与首个分支
Branch example: root and first branch
lecture: 最大化 8x₁+5x₂，约束 x₁+x₂≤6、9x₁+5x₂≤45、x≥0 整数。根 LP 解 (3.75,2.25)，值 41.25。P₁ 增加 x₁≥4，得 (4,1.8)，值 41；P₂ 为 x₁≤3，暂后处理。P₁ 再分 x₂≥2 的 P₃（不可行）和 x₂≤1 的 P₄；P₄ 得 (40/9,1)，值 365/9≈40.5556。

Maximize 8x₁+5x₂ subject to x₁+x₂≤6,9x₁+5x₂≤45 and nonnegative integers. Root optimum (3.75,2.25) has value 41.25. P₁ adds x₁≥4 and gives (4,1.8), value 41; P₂ adds x₁≤3 and is deferred. P₁ splits into infeasible P₃ with x₂≥2 and P₄ with x₂≤1, yielding (40/9,1), value 365/9≈40.5556.
explanation: P₃ 不可行因 9×4+5×2=46>45。第 37 页的 4.44、40.55 是截短显示，计算应使用分数。
P₃ is infeasible since 9×4+5×2=46>45. Page 37 truncates to 4.44 and 40.55; use fractions in calculations.

title: 分支定界例题：证明最优 40
Branch example: certify value 40
lecture: P₄ 按 x₁ 分支：P₅ 加 x₁≥5，解 (5,0)，值 40，成为在位解；P₆ 加 x₁≤4，解 (4,1)，值 37，剪枝。回到 P₂ 得 (3,3)，值 39，也剪枝。所有节点处理完，整数最优为 (5,0)，值 40。第 41 页保留完整树图。课件讨论 backtracking 与 jumptracking，并允许按指定 gap 提前停止。

P₄ splits on x₁: P₅ with x₁≥5 gives integer (5,0), value 40, becoming incumbent; P₆ with x₁≤4 gives (4,1), value 37 and is fathomed. P₂ gives (3,3), value 39 and is also fathomed. All nodes are disposed of, certifying (5,0), value 40. Page 41 shows the tree. The lecture discusses backtracking, jumptracking and stopping at a specified gap.
explanation: 课件图中的 41.25 是沿用的根上界，并非每一步都更新后的最紧 best bound。提前 gap 停止应报告近似证书，不应宣称严格最优。
The tree retains root bound 41.25 rather than updating the tightest best bound at every step. Gap-based early termination should report an approximation certificate, not exact optimality.

title: Gomory 割：保留整数点、切掉分数点
Gomory cut: preserve integers, remove fractions
lecture: 割平面循环：解松弛→若整数则结束→否则加入全部整数可行点都满足、当前分数解不满足的不等式。例题最优表行 x₁−1.25s₁+0.25s₂=3.75，取 floor(−1.25)=−2，得到 0.75−0.75s₁−0.25s₂≤0。代入 s₁=6−x₁−x₂、s₂=45−9x₁−5x₂，得割 3x₁+2x₂≤15。

Cutting planes repeatedly solve the relaxation and add valid inequalities excluding fractional optima. From x₁−1.25s₁+0.25s₂=3.75 and floor(−1.25)=−2, obtain 0.75−0.75s₁−0.25s₂≤0. Substitute s₁=6−x₁−x₂ and s₂=45−9x₁−5x₂ to get 3x₁+2x₂≤15.
explanation: 左端为整数，右端≤0.75，所以左端≤0；这说明割为何有效。旧 LP 点代入得 15.75>15，故被切掉。割的质量影响收敛；课件提到求解器会组合多种割。
The left side is integer while the right is ≤0.75, so the left must be ≤0; this proves validity. The old LP point gives 15.75>15 and is removed. Cut quality matters; solvers may combine cut families.

title: 强模型：逐项联动优于聚合
Strong formulations: individual versus aggregate links
lecture: 设施选址逐项约束 xᵢⱼ≤yⱼ 与聚合约束 Σᵢxᵢⱼ≤myⱼ 对二元变量等价；前者约束数 m+mn，后者 m+n。松弛后前者更紧，所以最小化下 p_聚合LP≤p_LP≤p_IP。较少约束不一定更容易求解整数问题。

Individual links xᵢⱼ≤yⱼ and aggregate links Σᵢxᵢⱼ≤myⱼ are equivalent for binaries, with m+mn versus m+n constraints. The individual relaxation is tighter, giving p_aggregateLP≤p_LP≤p_IP for minimization. Fewer constraints do not necessarily make an IP easier.
formulas: p_{\rm aggregate\ LP}\le p_{\rm LP}\le p_{\rm IP}
explanation: 例如 m=2、某设施分配 (1,0)、y=0.5 满足聚合 1≤2×0.5，却违反逐项 1≤0.5，展示聚合松弛多出的分数点。
With m=2, assignments (1,0) and y=0.5 satisfy aggregate 1≤2×0.5 but violate individual 1≤0.5, illustrating an extra fractional point.

title: 凸包与模型质量
Convex hull and formulation quality
lecture: 对相同整数可行集 T，松弛区域越接近 conv(T)，模型越强。若 P_A 包含于 P_B，A 至少与 B 一样强。第 54 页黑点是整数可行集，蓝色为凸包，额外红色区域属于松弛但不属于整数凸包。

For the same integer set T, a relaxation closer to conv(T) is stronger. If P_A is contained in P_B, A is at least as strong. Page 54 shows integer points in black, the hull in blue and additional relaxation area in red.

title: TSP 与子回路：课件公式需核对
TSP and subtours: formulas needing review
lecture: 目标是访问所有节点一次并返回的最低成本巡回。第 56 页比较完整路线 1–5–2–4–3–6–1 与两个小环 1–2–6–1、3–4–5–3。仅局部入出度限制不能排除子回路。第 57 页比较 MTZ 与 DFJ：前者较少约束并加顺序变量，后者约束多但松弛更强。第 58 页总结整数模型灵活性与求解难度的权衡。

The goal is a minimum-cost tour visiting every node once and returning. Page 56 compares tour 1–5–2–4–3–6–1 with subtours 1–2–6–1 and 3–4–5–3. Local degree conditions do not ensure connectivity. Page 57 contrasts MTZ (fewer constraints and ordering variables) with stronger but larger DFJ; page 58 summarizes the flexibility/computational trade-off.
explanation: 补充说明（非课件原公式）：有向版本通常固定起点 1，仅对 i,j∈{2,…,n}, i≠j 加 uᵢ−uⱼ+nxᵢⱼ≤n−1，配合 1≤uᵢ≤n−1 与每点一入一出。DFJ 对真子集 2≤|S|≤n−1 加 Σ_{i,j∈S}xᵢⱼ≤|S|−1。无向版本应使用每点度数=2。

Added clarification, not the original slide formula: a directed version fixes depot 1 and applies uᵢ−uⱼ+nxᵢⱼ≤n−1 only for distinct i,j∈{2,…,n}, with 1≤uᵢ≤n−1 and one incoming/outgoing arc per node. DFJ uses proper subsets 2≤|S|≤n−1. An undirected formulation instead requires degree two.
review: 需要人工核对：第 55 页文字称无向图，公式却写每点一入一出的有向形式；第 57 页 MTZ 写“所有弧”，没有排除起点，照抄会排除完整巡回。这里不把这两页公式当成已核实的可直接运行模型。

Manual review: page 55 says undirected but uses directed in/out constraints. Page 57 applies MTZ to all arcs without excluding a depot, which would eliminate full tours. These formulas are not treated as a verified executable formulation.

title: 修改版 Giapetto 与 Workshop 割
Modified Giapetto and workshop cut
lecture: 本次模型与旧 Giapetto 不同：最大化 4x₁+3x₂，3x₁+2x₂≤100，2x₁+3x₂≤102，非负整数。课件 LP 表给 x₁=96/5=19.2、x₂=106/5=21.2、Z=702/5=140.4；x₁ 行为 x₁+(3/5)s₁−(2/5)s₂=96/5。第 60 页要求解释非整数问题并推导割，没有给答案。

This differs from the earlier Giapetto: maximize 4x₁+3x₂ with 3x₁+2x₂≤100,2x₁+3x₂≤102 and nonnegative integers. The tableau gives x₁=96/5,x₂=106/5,Z=702/5, with row x₁+(3/5)s₁−(2/5)s₂=96/5. Page 60 asks for an integrality explanation and cut, without answers.
explanation: Codex 推导：floor(−2/5)=−1，其小数部分为 3/5；所以 (3/5)s₁+(3/5)s₂≥1/5。代入 s₁=100−3x₁−2x₂、s₂=102−2x₁−3x₂，得 3x₁+3x₂≤121；利用整数性还可加强为 x₁+x₂≤40。这不是老师给出的书面答案。

Codex derivation: floor(−2/5)=−1 and its fractional part is 3/5, so (3/5)s₁+(3/5)s₂≥1/5. Substitute the two slacks to get 3x₁+3x₂≤121. Integrality further strengthens this to x₁+x₂≤40. This is not a written instructor answer.

summary: 先建正确逻辑，再争取紧松弛。LP 界帮助剪枝，整数可行解提供在位值，零 gap 才是严格最优证书。来源有疑点的 TSP 公式已单独标注。

First model the logic correctly, then strengthen the relaxation. LP bounds prune nodes, feasible integers provide incumbents, and zero gap certifies optimality. Questionable TSP slide formulas are flagged.

question: 最大化问题在位值 40、活跃节点上界 39.5，是否继续该节点？
With incumbent 40 and a node upper bound 39.5 in maximization, should it be explored?
answer: 可剪枝，它不可能改善在位解。
No; it cannot improve the incumbent.

question: floor(−1.25) 是多少？为何不是 −1？
What is floor(−1.25), and why not −1?
answer: −2；floor 是不大于原数的最大整数。
−2, the greatest integer no larger than the number.

question: x≤y 是否要求选 B 就一定选 A？
Does x≤y force A whenever B is selected?
answer: 不要求；(x,y)=(0,1) 允许，仅表达 A⇒B。
No; (0,1) is allowed. It encodes only A⇒B.
